title: not_yet cites a closed work package, and the wrong one, in the two seam sites that speak when a command is unavailable
body:
Both `not_yet` sites in the seam tell a user their command is gated on work that finished six weeks ago, and one of them cites the wrong work package as well.

    lib/resolve:814  report_not_yet "$DEVBIN_INVOKE $cmd $opt" "the built-in command library (ST0001/WP-08)"
    lib/resolve:968  not_yet        "$DEVBIN_INVOKE $cmd"      "the built-in command library (ST0001/WP-14)"

Each prints `gated on: the built-in command library (ST0001/WP-NN)` through `lib/helpers:157`. All 18 of ST0001's work packages read Done and ST0001 completed 2026-08-10, so both messages point the reader at a closed thread. WP-14 is "Built-ins: Surfaces (server, iex, cli, repl)" and WP-08 is "Built-ins: Gates (check, test)" -- `build`, the command that actually reaches the second site, is WP-15. So the citation is wrong independently of being stale.

TWO SURFACES DISAGREE ABOUT ONE COMMAND, AND THE WRONG ONE IS THE ONE THAT SPEAKS AT THE MOMENT OF FAILURE. `bin/devbin build` exits 3 with the gating line above. `bin/devbin help --why` says of the same command: `devbin ships the name only -- declare commands.build.run or add bin/.devbin/cmd/build`. The second is true and actionable today; the first tells the reader to wait. A user hits the runtime message, not `--why`, precisely when they are blocked.

EXPOSURE IS MEASURED HERE AND NOT BEYOND. In devbin's own tree, `build` alone reaches a not_yet site (rc 3); clean, db, server, repl, cli, fullcycle and dormancy exit 2, scoped out by language before they get there -- so this tree exercises the WP-14 site and never the WP-08 one. WP-08's site is the OPTION path, reached when a declared option has no run and no handler, and whether any estate reaches it is a function of that estate's config rather than of this one. The fleet-wide figure is NOT established: measuring it here and reporting it for 13 estates would be a premise transferring no better than a rate. vc holds the fleet on disk and has the measurement.

FIX is two strings and a work-package number. It is vendored seam, so it reaches 13 estates on the next sweep and is hv's call on timing; it does not warrant a cut of its own. It rides with 6800d9f, for which vc is already the named carrier.

Found by cc during the 2026-09-22 as-written-vs-as-built doc audit; confirmed independently by vc.
